scope: MS enabled-entry disables with unchanged surviving aggregate flags, or complete enabled-entry shutdown. Configured eligibility/support only.

consumer.slots: enabled rows 0..4 populate root+0x448+i*0x20; reviewed same-object initialization zeroes all six flag/feature pairs, including fallback slot5
consumer.selector: actual loaded Pstate LPWR index -> byte2 of the understood 18-byte index row; FF/out-of-range selects slot5
consumer.masks: controller1 attr36 checks controller4/6 support then shares the MS enabled-slot route used by controllers4/6
consumer.type1_role1: selected slot feature bit0x2000, derived from raw flag0x10; this does not independently test slot enabled
consumer.type7_role1: attr805 uses selected slot feature bit0x100, derived from raw flag0x20; support aggregate also includes feature0x100000 (raw0x40 and construction-time controller6 condition)
consumer.clearing: all MS enables absent clears controller4/6 support, shared type1 role1 and type7 role1 through the understood cleanup paths

limits: Native controller4 support and exact affected readbacks are required; controllers6/16 must independently report unsupported for this qualified profile.

Partial changes with unresolved aggregate-flag loss, ambiguous routes, or no independent configured-state change are refused.
